name: MP Materials

eyebrow.en: MP Materials Corp. · Class A · Las Vegas, Nevada
eyebrow.zh: MP Materials · A类股 · 内华达州拉斯维加斯

title.en: America's rare earth mine, backed by Washington.
title.zh: 美国的稀土矿，华盛顿撑腰。

lede.en: MP owns Mountain Pass, the only scaled US rare earth mine, and is building magnet factories. A Department of War deal sets a $110/kg price floor for its NdPr and fully contracts its new 10X magnet plant. Q3 revenue of $148M beat estimates, helped by a one-off defense sale, and GM magnet sales start in Q4, but GAAP losses and heavy capex continue.
lede.zh: MP 拥有美国唯一规模化稀土矿 Mountain Pass，并在兴建磁材工厂。与战争部的协议为其 NdPr 设定每公斤 110 美元价格下限，并包销新建的 10X 磁材工厂。第三季营收 1.48 亿美元超预期，部分得益于一笔一次性国防销售；通用汽车磁材销售将于第四季开始，但 GAAP 亏损与高额资本开支仍在持续。

s.en: 2027 consensus adj. EPS $0.74 · trailing GAAP n/m (loss) · P/S ~12×
s.zh: 2027 年一致预期调整后每股 $0.74 · GAAP 历史为亏损，不适用 · 市销率约 12 倍

s.en: no company guidance · adj. EPS est. $0.02
s.zh: 公司不提供指引 · 调整后每股预期 $0.02
2026 第四季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock has fallen by more than half from its 52-week high near $73.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。股价较 52 周高点近 $73 下跌逾一半。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Since Q4 2025 revenue includes price-protection income from the Department of War ($8.1M in Q3 2026); Q3 product revenue was $147.7M, including a one-off $31.6M SEG+ sale. MP gives no revenue guidance, so the Q4 bar is analyst consensus for product revenue.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。自 2025 年第四季起营收含战争部价格保障收入（2026 年第三季 810 万美元）；第三季产品收入 1.477 亿，含一笔 3160 万美元的一次性 SEG+ 销售。MP 不提供营收指引，故第四季柱为分析师对产品收入的一致预期。

s.zh: 同比 +191% · 含 810 万价格保障收入及 3160 万一次性销售
营收 1.335 亿 · 磁材板块 530 万

p.en: The Department of War price floor of $110/kg (worth $8.1M in Q3) and a fully contracted 10X magnet plant reduce commodity-price risk.
p.zh: 战争部每公斤 110 美元价格下限（第三季带来 810 万美元）及包销的 10X 磁材工厂降低了商品价格风险。

p.en: GM qualification is complete, with saleable magnet deliveries and revenue starting in Q4. NdPr output topped 1,000 t for the first time.
p.zh: 通用汽车认证已完成，可销售磁材交付及收入将于第四季开始。NdPr 产量首次突破 1000 吨。

p.en: Capex was $420M in the first nine months against $500–600M guided for 2026. Free cash flow was −$125M in Q3 and cash fell to $1.34B.
p.zh: 前九个月资本开支 4.2 亿美元，2026 年指引为 5–6 亿。第三季自由现金流 −1.25 亿，现金降至 13.4 亿。

p.en: A $31.6M one-off SEG+ sale flattered Q3 revenue; the GAAP net loss was $20.7M and magnetics revenue fell 15% during the switch to magnets.
p.zh: 3160 万美元一次性 SEG+ 销售推高了第三季营收；GAAP 净亏损 2070 万美元，转产磁材期间磁材板块收入下降 15%。

h.zh: 中国出口管制暂停到期

p.en: China's one-year pause on its rare earth export curbs is due to expire.
p.zh: 中国为期一年的稀土出口管制暂停措施将到期。

h.zh: 首笔通用汽车磁材收入

p.en: Saleable magnet deliveries to GM begin at the Independence plant in Texas.
p.zh: 德州 Independence 工厂开始向通用汽车交付可销售磁材。

p.en: First quarter with magnet revenue; watch 2027 capex plans.
p.zh: 首个含磁材收入的季度；关注 2027 年资本开支计划。

p.en: Vertical construction has started; output is fully contracted.
p.zh: 主体建设已开工；产出已全部包销。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 5, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with MP Materials Corp.

guide: Dec 2026 · analyst consensus (product revenue, implied by ~$451M FY)
2026年12月 · 分析师一致预期（产品收入，由约 4.51 亿全年预期推算）

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 2021 to Q3 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第四季至 2026 年第三季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: MP made good money in 2021–2022 when rare earth prices peaked, then burned cash every quarter since early 2023 as prices fell and it built separation and magnet plants. Q3 2026 free cash flow was −$125M: operating cash flow was −$13M despite $41M of adjusted EBITDA, as receivables rose, and capex was $113M.
read.zh: 2021–2022 年稀土价格高企时 MP 盈利丰厚，此后价格下跌、公司兴建分离与磁材工厂，自 2023 年初起每季烧钱。2026 年第三季自由现金流 −1.25 亿美元：尽管调整后 EBITDA 达 4100 万，应收账款增加使经营现金流为 −1300 万，资本开支 1.13 亿。

read.en: Capex reached $420M in the first nine months against $500–600M guided for 2026, implying roughly $130M in Q4. I assume about $150M a quarter in 2027 for 10X and heavy rare earth work, with operating cash flow improving as GM magnet sales start, for about −$400M over four quarters. That leaves close to $940M of cash and investments by Sep 2027, against $936M of debt.
read.zh: 前九个月资本开支 4.2 亿美元，2026 年指引 5–6 亿，意味着第四季约 1.3 亿。我假设 2027 年每季约 1.5 亿用于 10X 及重稀土项目，经营现金流随通用汽车磁材销售启动而改善，四季合计约 −4 亿美元。至 2027 年 9 月现金及投资约剩 9.4 亿，债务为 9.36 亿。

p.en: $420M of capex in the first nine months of 2026, mostly for magnetics and the 10X site.
p.zh: 2026 年前九个月资本开支 4.2 亿美元，主要用于磁材及 10X 厂址。

p.en: Trade receivables rose to $64M from $15M at the end of 2025 as sales grew.
p.zh: 随销售增长，应收账款由 2025 年底的 1500 万增至 6400 万美元。

p.en: The Department of War tops up NdPr sales to $110/kg; $8.1M in Q3.
p.zh: 战争部将 NdPr 售价补足至每公斤 110 美元；第三季 810 万。

p.en: GM deliveries start in Q4 on top of NdPr sales above 1,000 t a quarter.
p.zh: 第四季开始向通用汽车交付，叠加每季逾 1000 吨的 NdPr 销量。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes any new government funding, customer prepayments or debt.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入新的政府资金、客户预付款或债务。
